title: CrAIyons
description: A drawing game that uses a CNN to recognize hand-drawn objects and score drawings based on similarity to target objects.

title: JARVIS
description: A computer vision system that uses MediaPipe and a Temporal Convolutional Network (TCN) to recognize hand gestures and control a web browser through real-time webcam input.

title: CityPulse
description: An interactive Tableau dashboard that visualizes and compares crime, housing, and transportation trends across New York City using public datasets.
